instruction: Review the existing calculator.py codebase to identify reusable calculation logic, current behavior, and any missing input validation before adding the UI.

summary: Reviewed calculator.py. Reusable logic is evaluate(), SafeEvaluator, CalculatorError, and format_result(). The Tkinter CalculatorApp is already present. Evaluation safely permits numeric constants and +, -, *, / with unary +/-; division by zero and malformed/unsupported expressions are converted to CalculatorError. UI input handling is basic: empty calculate is ignored, digit/operator input is not fully validated, decimal handling is heuristic, backspace can leave malformed expressions, and calculate displays errors but does not prevent invalid intermediate states. Existing assertions cover arithmetic, formatting, and division-by-zero. No UI changes or code generation were made.
